name: Perform Pcr And Gel Electrophoresis
description: Performs PCR amplification of a target transgene and visualizes results using agarose gel electrophoresis.
detailed_description: Performs PCR amplification of a target transgene and visualizes results using agarose gel electrophoresis.
when_to_use: When you need perform pcr and gel electrophoresis analysis

parameters.genomic_dna: [Required] Path to file containing genomic DNA sequence in FASTA format or the sequence itself (str)
parameters.forward_primer: [Optional] Forward primer sequence. If not provided, will be designed based on target_region
parameters.reverse_primer: [Optional] Reverse primer sequence. If not provided, will be designed based on target_region
parameters.target_region: [Optional] Tuple of (start, end) positions for the target region in the genomic DNA
